# WechatOpenSDK-XCFramework 2.0.5

This directory contains the official Wechat OpenSDK XCFramework used by the
iOS application. It is vendored to keep local and GitHub Actions builds from
depending on the availability of the upstream download CDN.

- Version: `2.0.5`
- Official archive: `https://dldir1.qq.com/WechatWebDev/opensdk/XCFramework/OpenSDK2.0.5.zip`
- Archive SHA-256: `00e7c16d76de05cae3f96fd051b928147a17e2047169a5a6e10631a293f0dd14`

When upgrading, create a new version directory instead of replacing this one,
then update the path in `iosApp/Podfile`.
